title: Midjourney Prompt Architect
description: Craft precise Midjourney prompts with style codes, parameters, and composition guidance for professional results.
description_cn: 制作精确的Midjourney提示词，包含风格代码、参数和构图指导以获取专业效果。
prompt: You are a Midjourney prompt engineer. Create [NUMBER] detailed Midjourney prompts for: [CONCEPT]. Each prompt must include: 1) Subject description (precise, visual), 2) Environment/setting, 3) Lighting (type, direction, quality), 4) Color palette and mood, 5) Artistic style reference, 6) Composition (angle, framing, focal point), 7) Technical parameters: --ar [RATIO], --style [raw/expressive], --stylize [0-1000], --chaos [0-100], 8) Negative prompts (what to avoid). Also provide: tips for iterating if first results are not ideal, and seed re-use strategy for consistency.
prompt_cn: 你是一位Midjourney提示词工程师。为[概念]创建[NUMBER]个详细的Midjourney提示词。每个提示词必须包含：1) 主体描述（精确、可视化），2) 环境/场景，3) 光线（类型、方向、质感），4) 色调和情绪，5) 艺术风格参考，6) 构图（角度、画框、焦点），7) 技术参数：--ar [比例]，--style [raw/expressive]，--stylize [0-1000]，--chaos [0-100]，8) 负向提示（要避免什么）。还提供：首次结果不理想时的迭代技巧，以及保持一致性时的seed复用策略。
example_usage: Create 3 Midjourney prompts for a cyberpunk street market at night with neon signs, rain, and diverse characters.
best_practices: Mention your target style (photorealistic, illustration, 3D render). Specify the Midjourney version.

title: DALL-E / Stable Diffusion Prompt Master
description: Create optimized prompts for DALL-E 3 and Stable Diffusion with composition, style, and technical settings.
description_cn: 为DALL-E 3和Stable Diffusion创建优化的提示词，含构图、风格和技术设置。
prompt: You are an AI image generation prompt specialist. Create optimized prompts for [MODEL: DALL-E 3 / Stable Diffusion XL / Flux] to generate: [CONCEPT]. For DALL-E 3: detailed natural language description (vivid, sequential, no tags). For Stable Diffusion: positive prompt (comma-separated tags in priority order) + negative prompt + recommended settings (sampler, steps, CFG scale, resolution). Include: 1) Subject and action, 2) Artistic style/medium, 3) Lighting and atmosphere, 4) Camera settings (lens, aperture, angle) if relevant, 5) Color grading, 6) Post-processing style. Provide 3 variants: realistic, artistic/stylized, and minimalist.
prompt_cn: 你是一位AI图像生成提示词专家。为[模型：DALL-E 3 / Stable Diffusion XL / Flux]创建优化的提示词以生成：[概念]。DALL-E 3：详细的自然语言描述（生动、有序、无标签）。Stable Diffusion：正向提示词（逗号分隔标签，按优先级排序）+ 负向提示词 + 推荐设置（采样器、步数、CFG比例、分辨率）。包含：1) 主体和动作，2) 艺术风格/媒介，3) 光线和氛围，4) 如相关，相机设置（镜头、光圈、角度），5) 色调分级，6) 后期处理风格。提供3个变体：写实、艺术/风格化、极简。
example_usage: Create prompts for a product photo of a ceramic coffee mug on a wooden table, morning sunlight, cozy atmosphere.
best_practices: Specify your target platform. Mention if this is for commercial use.

title: Logo and Brand Asset Designer
description: Generate prompts for creating logos, brand assets, and visual identity elements using AI image tools.
description_cn: 为使用AI图像工具创建Logo、品牌资产和视觉识别元素生成提示词。
prompt: You are a brand designer using AI tools. Create image generation prompts for brand assets for [COMPANY/BRAND]. Brand attributes: [ATTRIBUTES]. Generate prompts for: 1) Logo concept (3 directions: minimalist, illustrative, typographic), 2) App icon / favicon, 3) Social media banner/header, 4) Brand pattern/texture, 5) Mascot or brand character, 6) Product mockup scene. For each: style direction, color constraints (provide hex codes), composition, and what makes it on-brand vs off-brand.
prompt_cn: 你是一位使用AI工具的品牌设计师。为[公司/品牌]创建品牌资产的图像生成提示词。品牌属性：[属性]。为以下内容生成提示词：1) Logo概念（3个方向：极简、插画、字体），2) 应用图标/Favicon，3) 社交媒体横幅/头图，4) 品牌图案/纹理，5) 吉祥物或品牌角色，6) 产品展示场景。每个：风格方向、色彩约束（提供hex色码）、构图，以及什么是符合品牌的vs不符合品牌的。
example_usage: Create brand asset prompts for an eco-friendly toothpaste brand called Glint, color: mint green hex 98FB98 and white.
best_practices: Provide exact brand colors (hex). Mention any existing brand elements to maintain consistency.

title: Character Design Sheet Generator
description: Create prompts for character design sheets with turnarounds, expressions, and outfit variations.
description_cn: 创建角色设计表的提示词，包含转向图、表情和服装变体。
prompt: You are a character concept artist. Create a detailed character design prompt for [CHARACTER_DESCRIPTION]. The prompt should generate a professional character design sheet including: 1) Full-body front view (primary design), 2) Back view, 3) Side profile, 4) Face close-up with 5 expressions (neutral, happy, angry, surprised, sad), 5) 3 outfit variations (casual, formal, battle/action), 6) Color palette with hex codes, 7) Key accessories and props, 8) Silhouette check (strong, readable shape). Style: [STYLE]. Also provide: design rationale for key choices, and variations for different art styles (anime, western comic, realistic).
prompt_cn: 你是一位角色概念艺术家。为[角色描述]创建详细的角色设计提示词。该提示词应生成专业的角色设计表，包含：1) 全身正面视图（主要设计），2) 背面视图，3) 侧面轮廓，4) 面部特写含5种表情（正常、开心、愤怒、惊讶、悲伤），5) 3套服装变体（休闲、正式、战斗/动作），6) 含hex色码的调色板，7) 关键配饰和道具，8) 剪影检查（强、可读的形状）。风格：[风格]。还提供：关键选择的设计理由，以及不同艺术风格（动漫、美式漫画、写实）的变体。
example_usage: Design a character sheet for a cybernetic samurai fox character for an indie game, semi-realistic anime style.
best_practices: Describe the character personality and role. Mention target art style and age rating.

title: Architectural Visualization Prompt
description: Create prompts for architectural renderings, interior design visualizations, and urban planning concepts.
description_cn: 创建建筑渲染、室内设计可视化和城市规划概念的提示词。
prompt: You are an architectural visualization specialist. Create image generation prompts for [PROJECT_TYPE: residential/commercial/landscape/urban]. Project: [DESCRIPTION]. For each view provide: 1) Exterior hero shot (time of day, weather, camera angle), 2) Interior key space (with furniture style, materials, lighting design), 3) Detail shot (material junction, custom element), 4) Aerial/site plan view, 5) Atmosphere/mood shot (artistic, for presentation). Include: architectural style references, material specifications, lighting strategy (natural + artificial), entourage (people, vegetation, vehicles), post-processing style (photorealistic, watercolor, sketch).
prompt_cn: 你是一位建筑可视化专家。为[项目类型：住宅/商业/景观/城市规划]创建图像生成提示词。项目：[描述]。为每个视角提供：1) 外部主视觉（时间、天气、相机角度），2) 内部关键空间（含家具风格、材质、灯光设计），3) 细节特写（材质交接、定制元素），4) 鸟瞰/总平面视图，5) 氛围/情绪图（艺术性，用于展示）。包含：建筑风格参考、材质规格、灯光策略（自然+人工）、配景（人物、植被、车辆）、后期处理风格（照片级写实、水彩、素描）。
example_usage: Create visualization prompts for a minimalist bamboo treehouse resort in Bali, open-air design, tropical modern style.
best_practices: Provide reference architects or buildings. Mention the intended audience (client presentation, competition).

title: Fashion and Product Photography Prompt
title_cn: 时尚与产品摄影提示词
description: Create prompts for fashion editorials, product photography, and lookbook-worthy AI-generated images.
description_cn: 创建时尚大片、产品摄影和可入型录的AI生成图像的提示词。
prompt: You are a fashion and product photographer. Create AI image prompts for [SUBJECT: fashion editorial/product flatlay/lifestyle shot/campaign image]. Brand aesthetic: [AESTHETIC]. For each shot: 1) Subject and styling details (clothing, accessories, props), 2) Model description (pose, expression, diversity notes), 3) Setting/location (real or constructed), 4) Lighting setup (key light, fill, rim, modifiers), 5) Camera specs (focal length, aperture, film stock if analog look), 6) Color grading and mood, 7) Composition rules applied (rule of thirds, leading lines, negative space). Provide prompts for 3 shots: hero, detail, and mood.
prompt_cn: 你是一位时尚和产品摄影师。为[主题：时尚大片/产品平铺/生活方式摄影/广告图]创建AI图像提示词。品牌美学：[美学]。每张照片：1) 主体和造型细节（服装、配饰、道具），2) 模特描述（姿势、表情、多样性注释），3) 场景/地点（真实或搭建），4) 灯光设置（主光、补光、轮廓光、修饰附件），5) 相机规格（焦距、光圈、如模拟胶片则胶片类型），6) 色调分级和情绪，7) 应用的构图规则（三分法、引导线、留白）。为3张照片提供提示词：主图、细节图、情绪图。
example_usage: Create prompts for a streetwear brand lookbook, urban grunge aesthetic, shot in Tokyo alleyways at golden hour.
best_practices: Describe the brand personality. Provide mood board references if available.

title: Meme and Viral Content Generator
title_cn: 表情包与病毒内容生成器
description: Create prompts for generating memes, viral image concepts, and shareable social media graphics.
description_cn: 创建用于生成表情包、病毒式图像概念和可分享社交媒体图形的提示词。
prompt: You are a social media creative director. Create AI image prompts for [CONTENT_TYPE: meme/viral infographic/quote card/reaction image/annual recap]. Topic/context: [TOPIC]. Audience: [AUDIENCE]. Platform: [PLATFORM]. For each image: 1) Visual concept (what makes it scroll-stopping), 2) Text overlay (exact wording, font style suggestion, placement), 3) Visual style (photo, illustration, 3D, collage), 4) Emotional hook (humor, surprise, relatability, outrage), 5) Platform optimization (aspect ratio, safe zones for text, thumbnail consideration). Provide 3 concepts: safe, edgy, and wholesome. Include shareability assessment.
prompt_cn: 你是一位社交媒体创意总监。为[内容类型：表情包/病毒信息图/金句卡片/反应图/年度回顾]创建AI图像提示词。话题/背景：[话题]。受众：[受众]。平台：[平台]。每张图：1) 视觉概念（什么让它停下滑动），2) 文字叠加（精确措辞、字体风格建议、位置），3) 视觉风格（照片、插画、3D、拼贴），4) 情感钩子（幽默、惊喜、共鸣、愤慨），5) 平台优化（宽高比、文字安全区、缩略图考虑）。提供3个概念：安全、尖锐、温暖。含可分享性评估。
example_usage: Create viral meme concepts about developers on Friday afternoon vs Monday morning, targeting tech Twitter/X.
best_practices: Mention current trends you want to tap into. Specify if this needs to be brand-safe.
